installed_artifact_journey.scope: Same machine, newly created isolated venv; explicitly selected local-version upgrade and paired pre-upgrade-data rollback when previous artifact supplied; not clean-machine qualification

ci.next: One final current-source check after terminal-output idle budgets aligned with existing total deadlines; exact original causes unknown. Repeated failure blocks release, not indefinite retries.

artifact_policy: Frozen pre-release bytes include explicit candidate/remote-pending status. Later out-of-band qualification/attestation records do not rewrite those artifacts or any0.1.x history.
byte_exactness: Existing project eol=lf applied to working tree; source archive members equal declared files, repeat build identical. Git object identity checked before push.
